Constant WET ERC20 token address used to pay swap costs.
Constant Waifusion ERC721 contract address that mints and stores the NFTs.
Constant maximum waifu supply (16384).
Constant maximum number of waifus swappable per call (3).
ETH price paid per committed waifu purchase.
WET token amount paid per swapped waifu.
Number of waifus currently stored in the dungeon.
Incrementing nonce mixed into the reveal randomness seed.
Mapping address to Commit{block,amount} of pending reveals.
Mapping index to Waifu{nftContract,waifuID} held by the dungeon.
Owner address maintained by the inherited Ownable contract.
Constructor initializing Ownable and therefore the owner.
Fallback receive function accepting plain ETH.
ERC721 receiver hook that registers funneled waifus into the dungeon.
Payable entry point committing an ETH purchase of num waifus.
Burns WET tokens and caller waifus, then commits a swap of the same count.
Reveals committed waifus, transfers them out and deletes the drawn entries.
Owner-only helper computing how many waifus can still be minted and funneling them.

Owner-only arbitrary NFT deposit into the dungeon storage.
Owner-only withdrawal of the whole ETH balance to the owner.
Owner-only call that withdraws ETH held by the Waifusion contract.
Owner-only transfer of the Waifusion contract ownership.
Owner-only setter of buyCost.
Owner-only setter of swapCost.
Internal helper storing the caller commit and resetting the commit timer.
Internal helper validating the commit and generating pseudo-random indices.
Ownable view returning the current owner.
Owner-only renunciation of ownership.
Owner-only transfer of contract ownership.
Modifier enforcing owner() == _msgSender() on privileged functions.
Context helper returning msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address used for commits, authorization and payout targets.
SafeERC20 low-level call pulling WET tokens from an arbitrary caller address.
ERC721 transferFrom burning the caller waifus to BURN_ADDR during swaps.
ERC721 safeTransferFrom to msg.sender in revealWaifus, invoking the receiver hook.
Raw ETH transfer of the contract balance to the owner in withdraw().
External call to IWaifusion.withdraw() moving ETH out of the Waifusion contract.

ERC721 transferFrom pulling an arbitrary NFT from the owner into the dungeon.

Memory copy of the Waifu struct being transferred out.
Cached waifuCount used for swap-and-pop deletion arithmetic.
MAX_NFT_SUPPLY minus the Waifusion total supply.

Cached contract ETH balance being withdrawn.

edges.reason: msg.sender keys commits[msg.sender], so commit state is bound to the caller address.
_revealRandomWaifus reads commits[msg.sender] to decide the caller reveal entitlement.
commitSwapWaifus pulls WET tokens and NFTs from msg.sender.
revealWaifus transfers the revealed NFTs to msg.sender.
withdraw both authorizes via the owner check and pays msg.sender.
onlyOwner compares owner() against _msgSender() which returns msg.sender.
onERC721Received requires msg.sender to equal the WAIFUSION constant.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender directly, propagating the untrusted address.
_msgSender() feeds the ownership comparison inside onlyOwner.
num determines the required msg.value and the commit amount to buy.
num is forwarded into _commitRandomWaifus to size the commit.
_ids drives the length of the swap and the burn loop.
operator is checked to equal address(this) before accepting the NFT.
from identifies the previous NFT owner in the receiver hook.
tokenId is validated against MAX_NFT_SUPPLY and stored as the waifu ID.
data is unused calldata of the receiver hook.
num sizes the mintNFT call and the ETH value forwarded.
nftContract is validated as non-zero and stored in the dungeon entry.
nftID is pulled from the caller and truncated into the Waifu struct.
newOwner becomes the new owner of the external Waifusion contract.
newBuyCost overwrites the buyCost state variable.
newSwapCost overwrites the swapCost state variable.
num is encoded into commits[msg.sender].amount.
amountToSwap bounds both the token transfer amount and the burn loop.
randomIDs drives both the NFT transfer loop and the deletion loop.
waifu holds the contract and ID used for the outbound safeTransferFrom.
count participates in count-1 swap-and-pop index arithmetic.
count is the operand of the count-1 deletion index computation.
remainingWaifus is compared with 20 to cap the funnel amount.
waifusToMint is passed to funnelWaifus.
balance is the ETH amount forwarded to the owner.
currentBlock is stored into commits[msg.sender].block.
commit supplies the block and amount used for the reveal window checks.
revealHash is hashed with revealNonce to derive the random index.
randomIndex is the seed index advanced for each revealed waifu.
nftPrice is multiplied by num to compute the ETH value sent.
buyCost is read to validate msg.value == num * buyCost.
swapCost is multiplied by the amount to determine the WET payment.
MAX_SWAP limits the number of waifus swapped per call.
MAX_NFT_SUPPLY bounds the remaining waifu computation.
WAIFUSION is the required msg.sender and stored nftContract.
WAIFUSION is queried for totalSupply().
WAIFUSION is queried for getNFTPrice() and mintNFT().
WAIFUSION is called for withdraw().
WAIFUSION is called for transferOwnership().
WET_TOKEN is the ERC20 token pulled for swap payment.
BURN_ADDR is both the WET recipient and the NFT burn destination.
waifuCount is the index used to store newly received waifus.
waifuCount is checked against the requested swap amount.
waifuCount bounds the random index and the deletion loop.
waifuCount is the index used to store arbitrarily added NFTs.
waifuCount is used as the modulus for the random index generation.
revealNonce is hashed into the randomness seed and then incremented.
commits[msg.sender] is written with the new block and amount.
commits[msg.sender] is read and cleared during reveal.
waifusInDungeon[waifuCount] is written with the received NFT.
waifusInDungeon entries are read, swapped and deleted during reveal.
waifusInDungeon[waifuCount] is written with the added NFT.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
The constructor sets _owner to the deployer.
waifuCount is incremented after each received NFT.
A new Waifu entry is written at index waifuCount.
waifuCount is decremented for every revealed waifu.
Revealed entries are overwritten by the last entry and then deleted.
waifuCount is incremented after an arbitrary NFT deposit.
A new Waifu entry is stored at index waifuCount.
commits[msg.sender].block and .amount are assigned.
commits[msg.sender].block is zeroed to prevent double reveals.
revealNonce is incremented after generating randomness.
buyCost is overwritten by newBuyCost.
swapCost is overwritten by newSwapCost.
transferOwnership writes the new _owner.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
The constructor calls _msgSender() to determine the initial owner.
commitBuyWaifus invokes _commitRandomWaifus.
commitSwapWaifus invokes _commitRandomWaifus after burning.
revealWaifus calls _revealRandomWaifus to obtain the indices.
funnelMaxWaifus calls funnelWaifus with the computed amount.
funnelWaifus first withdraws ETH from the Waifusion contract.
funnelMaxWaifus is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
funnelWaifus is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
addNFTToDungeon is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdraw is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdrawFromWaifusion is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setWaifusionOwner is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBuyCost is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setSwapCost is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
commitSwapWaifus performs a low-level external ERC20 call pulling caller funds.
commitSwapWaifus burns each caller waifu through transferFrom.
revealWaifus performs safeTransferFrom to the caller before cleaning up storage.
Reveal cleanup decrements waifuCount and uses count-1 indexing.
withdraw forwards the whole balance to the owner.
withdrawFromWaifusion triggers an external call on the Waifusion contract.
funnelWaifus mints NFTs paying num * nftPrice ETH.
setWaifusionOwner hands the Waifusion contract ownership to a new address.
addNFTToDungeon pulls an arbitrary NFT from the owner via transferFrom.
safeTransferFrom to a contract recipient invokes onERC721Received, allowing re-entry.
A contract recipient of the ETH transfer may execute its receive/fallback and re-enter.

normalization_plan.reason: The num parameter only exists to size the commit and ETH check inside commitBuyWaifus.
The _ids array is only consumed by the burn loop of commitSwapWaifus.
operator is a transitory hook argument validated inside onERC721Received.
from is a transitory hook argument describing the previous NFT owner.
tokenId is validated and stored only inside onERC721Received.
data is unused calldata of the receiver hook.
num only drives the mint amount and ETH value in funnelWaifus.
nftContract is validated and stored only by addNFTToDungeon.
nftID is transferred and stored only by addNFTToDungeon.
newOwner is only forwarded to the external transferOwnership call.
newBuyCost is only assigned to the buyCost state variable.
newSwapCost is only assigned to the swapCost state variable.
num is only encoded into the caller Commit struct.
amountToSwap is a cached length local scoped to commitSwapWaifus.
randomIDs is the loop driver local inside revealWaifus.
waifu is a memory copy used only within the reveal transfer loop.
count caches waifuCount for the cleanup arithmetic in revealWaifus.
remainingWaifus is a computation local of funnelMaxWaifus.
waifusToMint is the capped amount passed on by funnelMaxWaifus.
balance is the ETH amount cached inside withdraw.
currentBlock is only used to stamp the commit block.
commit is a memory copy of the caller Commit read by _revealRandomWaifus.
revealHash is an internal randomness seed local of _revealRandomWaifus.
randomIndex is the advancing index local of the reveal loop.
nftPrice is queried and immediately multiplied in funnelWaifus.
